content.short: STASIS is a tokenization platform for fully backed digital assets, reserve verification, and regulated fiat-linked products.
content.description: STASIS is a tokenization platform focused on issuing fully backed digital assets with reserve verification, compliance support, and institutional-grade operations. The company works across smart contract issuance, custody coordination, audits, and reporting so tokenized assets can remain transparently backed by offchain collateral. Its best-known products connect fiat-linked assets with blockchain rails while emphasizing accountability, verification, and regulated asset infrastructure.
